title: Change Freeze Override Approval Lost Between Slack Workspaces
question: For the postmortem, was the deploy of PR-4892 a valid change freeze exception per Meridian's documented change management policy?

contributor.name: Jordan Kim
contributor.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / Incident Commander
contributor.domain_expertise: Incident response, change management, SLA enforcement, postmortem process

choices: No — the exception was never valid because it lacked a Jira Change Request ticket and was not posted in #change-management, regardless of Divya's informal approval
Yes — Marco communicated the exception in #engineering which constitutes a written channel notification; the only violation was the shortened canary window
Yes — VP Engineering (Divya) gave explicit approval via DM, which constitutes written authorization; the deploy was valid but the canary duration was the root policy violation
No — the exception expired because Divya's approval was given on May 12 for 'tonight' but the deploy happened on May 14, making the approval stale
